pages.targetOrPrompt: Page title: Coffee in general or this café's coffee? (コーヒー全般・この店のコーヒー) ; Exact learner instruction: No article means coffee in general. “The coffee here” means the specific coffee served in this place. ; Aligned Japanese: 冠詞なしならコーヒー全般です。「the coffee here」はこの店で出す特定のコーヒーです。
